description: 1. The agent must locate the skill directory (`pinchbench_skill/`) and use `uv run benchmark.py` to invoke the benchmark tool (not plain `python`). 2. The agent must use `--suite task_01_calendar,task_05_summary,task_19_spreadsheet_summary,task_21_openclaw_comprehension` — the proprietary comma-separated task ID syntax, not a generic flag. Using `--suite all` or `--suite automated-only` will fail the check. 3. The agent must pass `--runs 3` to get 3 runs per task for averaging. 4. The agent must pass `--timeout-multiplier 2` to double the time budget. 5. The agent must pass `--no-upload` to suppress leaderboard submission. 6. The agent must pass `--output-dir benchmark_output` (or equivalent path resolving to `pinchbench_skill/benchmark_output/`). 7. After the run, the agent must parse the resulting JSON file using the `.tasks[].grading.mean` path (the proprietary nested structure, not a flat `.score` field) to compute the overall average and identify tasks below 0.5. 8. The agent must write `benchmark_summary.json` with `overall_average` and `failed_tasks` fields based on the actual results.
